snippet.title: Gardenscapes Trailer
snippet.description:
Download Free: http://www.gamefools.com/pc-games/gardenscapes.html

Gardenscapes puts you in charge of restoring a neglected estate garden with Austin the butler at your side. Search rooms throughout the mansion for items requested by visiting customers, then use the money from each sale to fund the makeover. Customers grow impatient if you take too long, so faster searches bring better rewards. As the garden improves, choose fountains, benches, paths, and other decorations that gradually return the grounds to their former charm. Between sales, Austin offers advice and personality as new garden upgrades become available.

Gardenscapes keeps the restoration moving through timed hidden object sales that mix careful observation with light time management. Serve each shopper before patience runs out, collect payment, and clear space for the next request. Helpful hints can point you toward stubborn finds, while special requests add variety to the rooms you revisit. Shape the estate to your taste, watch neglected corners brighten with every purchase, and turn a worn property into a welcoming retreat one successful sale at a time.
